name: Taverna Tony's California Salad

ingredients.name: red bell pepper, cut into 1/4- by 2-inch strips
green bell pepper, cut into 1/4- by 2-inch strips
drained and thinly sliced oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes
goat cheese, crumbled into large pieces

instructions.primary_message: For the Dressing: In a large bowl, whisk all ingredients together until an emulsified dressing forms.

For the Salad: Add mesclun, red and green bell peppers, and sundried tomatoes to the dressing bowl and toss to coat. Gently toss avocado with dressed mesclun. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Transfer to a large serving platter (or leave in large serving bowl). Top with crumbled goat cheese and walnuts. Serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: dinner salad recipe, Taverna Tony's California Salad, california salad

description: This easy California-style salad with avocado, goat cheese, and walnuts comes together in 15 minutes. A lightly emulsified Greek dressing and smart tossing technique make it restaurant-worthy.
notes:
Optional substitutions: mesclun mix → spring mix

Notes: For a punchier dressing, Dijon mustard may be substituted for the mayonnaise.
Feel free to use just red or green bell pepper, if desired.
Creamy block feta made from sheep's or goat's milk can be substituted for goat cheese.

Make-ahead and storage: The dressing can be made and refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 days. Bring to room temperature and whisk to recombine before using.
author: Amanda Luchtel
